title: Mondaily AI eval fixture (one JSON object per line in *.jsonl)

context.description: Optional grounding context supplied to the model (sources, transcript, records).

params.description: Optional generation params (temperature, max_tokens, guided-json flag).

must_refuse.description: True when the correct behavior is to decline (out-of-scope/unknown/unsafe).

expected.description: Ground truth. For structured classes: schema + fields. For prose: rubric_notes.

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must satisfy (extraction/discovery).

rubric_notes.description: What a correct answer must contain (prose classes).

metrics.description: Which rubric metrics apply to this item.

source.description: Provenance. sanitized-real requires the HARNESS_DESIGN.md §4 gate.
